label: The save workflow's documented CLI log command is unrunnable as written, missing the scope flags that log requires
detail: save.md instructs the append through three forms. The first, `node .opencode/hooks/goal/bin/goal.cjs log "<item> | <state> | <evidence>"`, omits --runtime/--session. log is not in actionsWithoutScope, so resolveGoalScope runs before dispatch and throws MISSING_RUNTIME/MISSING_SESSION_ID; goalOptions defaults only workspace to process.cwd(). The tool form (opencode_goal action log) is fine and the packet-log form on the same line is scope-exempt and complete (its action is in actionsWithoutScope and it passes --workspace anyway). The cell splitting is correct in both runLog and runPacketLog, so only the missing flags are wrong. Fix: add --runtime <r> --session <id> --workspace "$PWD", or route to packet-log.
